# CS Studio

CS Studio is an online learning platform for computer science, offering interactive courses, coding problems, and AI-powered guidance.

## Public Resources
- [Home](https://cs-studio.in/): Landing page with platform overview.
- [Sign In](https://cs-studio.in/signin): User login portal.
- [Sign Up](https://cs-studio.in/signup): Account creation page.
- [Verify Certificate](https://cs-studio.in/verify-certificate): Public portal to verify the authenticity of certificates issued by CS Studio.

## Platform Features
- Interactive coding environments
- AI-assisted learning and problem-solving
- Structured courses across various computer science topics
- Progress tracking and skill certificates

For more information, please visit https://cs-studio.in
